zoe_sales: Lumen Health POC: exec demo tomorrow. they report slow first-byte (~2.1s) and bursts of 429s. can we triage quickly?
matt_se: on it. hosted or private env? any logs?
lumen_engineer: hosted. sample: ```2026-03-22T11:05:10Z id=ln100 model=redwood-13b ftb_ms=2120 status=200
2026-03-22T11:05:11Z id=ln101 model=redwood-13b status=429 err=rate_limit_exceeded
2026-03-22T11:05:12Z id=ln102 model=redwood-13b ftb_ms=2195 status=200```
ravi_oncall: quick read: high cold-cache miss + org concurrency cap. org=lumen warmups=false cache_miss_rate=80% concurrency_limit=25. 429s align with short retry bursts.
matt_se: recommend: 1) enable transient warm pool for demo window 2) bump per-org concurrency 25->70 3) ask client to run small warmup & reuse connections 4) suggest prefix seeding to reduce tokenization work
zoe_sales: they need a cost number to approve.
matt_se: rough: 1xA100 warm pool for 2 hours ~ $85 infra uplift. token costs negligible for demo.
corp_security: KMS question: hosted KMS onboarding needs signed DPA addendum + customer-provided key (AWS/GCP/Azure). typical binding time 3-5 business days; we can supply SOC2 artifacts.
lumen_engineer: can you flip warm pool now? demo at 09:30 PT tomorrow.
ravi_oncall: scheduled warm pool and concurrency override for 2026-03-23T09:00:00-07:00 -> 2026-03-23T11:30:00-07:00. monitoring on.
lumen_engineer: ran warmup script and retested: FTb samples 150ms, 210ms, 170ms; no 429 in 12m smoke. huge improvement. thanks.
zoe_sales: next steps: 1) send $85 uplift estimate and KMS checklist 2) recommend dedicated reserved for sustained low-latency 3) schedule 30m post-demo retro. matt/ravi/corp_security please join.
matt_se: will join.
ravi_oncall: will join.
corp_security: will join.
zoe_sales: closing thread: root cause = cold-cache + concurrency cap; mitigation = warm pool + client warmup + concurrency bump. :white_check_mark:
